time_format: ISO 8601 UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ; ranges are [start, end) with exclusive end

series_fields.name: sun_az_deg
series_fields.description: Sun azimuth [0,360), clockwise from local north

series_fields.name: sun_el_deg
series_fields.description: Sun center elevation (airless, apparent)

series_fields.name: sun_dist_km
series_fields.description: Observer -> Sun center distance

series_fields.name: sun_semidiam_deg
series_fields.description: Solar angular semi-diameter

series_fields.name: horizon_el_sun_deg
series_fields.description: Terrain horizon elevation at the Sun azimuth

series_fields.name: sun_clearance_deg
series_fields.description: sun_el - horizon_el_sun (Sun center)

series_fields.name: sun_fraction
series_fields.description: Visible fraction of the solar disc (0..1)

series_fields.name: sun_visible
series_fields.description: Upper limb above the terrain horizon

series_fields.name: power_horizontal
series_fields.description: Relative power of a flat-lying panel (0..1)

series_fields.name: power_tracking
series_fields.description: Relative power of a Sun-tracking panel (0..1)

series_fields.name: irradiance_tracking_wm2
series_fields.description: Irradiance on a Sun-tracking panel

series_fields.name: earth_az_deg
series_fields.description: Earth azimuth [0,360)

series_fields.name: earth_el_deg
series_fields.description: Earth center elevation

series_fields.name: earth_dist_km
series_fields.description: Observer -> Earth center distance

series_fields.name: earth_semidiam_deg
series_fields.description: Earth angular semi-diameter

series_fields.name: horizon_el_earth_deg
series_fields.description: Terrain horizon elevation at the Earth azimuth

series_fields.name: earth_clearance_deg
series_fields.description: earth_el - horizon_el_earth

series_fields.name: earth_fraction
series_fields.description: Visible fraction of the Earth disc (informative)

series_fields.name: earth_visible
series_fields.description: earth_clearance > min_earth_clearance_deg (DTE link possible)

series_fields.name: both_visible
series_fields.description: sun_visible AND earth_visible

series_fields.name: hours_until_sunset
series_fields.description: 0 if dark; else hours to the next dark window; null = none before run end

series_fields.name: hours_until_sunrise
series_fields.description: 0 if lit; else hours to the next sunrise; null = none before run end

series_fields.name: hours_until_earthset
series_fields.description: 0 if Earth not visible; else hours to the next comms gap

series_fields.name: hours_until_earthrise
series_fields.description: 0 if Earth visible; else hours to the next Earth rise
